topic: Five reasons a gaming PC stutters, ranked
title: Top 5: Why Your PC Stutters #siliconverdict #pcgaming #techtop5
description: Five common reasons a gaming PC stutters, counted down from five to one, with the mechanism behind each.
pinned_comment: Heat or memory? Reply with one word.

scenes.narration: Your PC doesn't stutter by accident. Here are five real reasons, ranked.
Stay to the end, because the number one cause surprises most people.
Number five: background apps quietly eat memory and processor time while you play.
Number four: when a chip gets too hot, it slows itself down to stay safe.
Number three: games streaming from a hard drive wait much longer than from an SSD.
At sixty frames per second, every frame gets about sixteen point seven milliseconds.
Number two: when memory runs out, Windows swaps data to disk, and frames hitch.
And number one: graphics memory runs out, so textures must be fetched mid-game.
Often, the fastest chip loses to a smaller, steadier pool of memory.
Check temperatures and memory before you spend money on a faster chip.
Follow for more tech. Which hurts more, heat or low memory?
